Messages.Author: Oortje4ever
Messages.Body:
This situation came up last sunday on a faboulus tournament here in
Utrecht, Netherlands, but thats beside the point.

Player A has a baltimore purge on his vamp. Player A is sending a few
vamps to torpor. One of the other players vampire has a fame and
enters toprpor.

Does player A pays a pool because there is a vampire in torpor with
fame during the untap phase?
Or does player A have an option to not take pool-loss because the
vampire wasnt there since the start of the untap?

The judge chose the first option.
I would do the same.

Oortje
